name: API Data Connector
description: Provides a field type, widgets and formatter that autocomplete/populate a field from an external JSON API, storing the picked id and name on the entity.
project_description: API Data Connector adds a Drupal field type whose form widgets fetch their options from an external JSON API instead of from local entities. A site builder configures, per field, the API URL, the query-parameter name, and which response keys map to the stored id and the displayed name (with optional nested dotted paths and extra mapped values). Editors then get a text autocomplete, a tags-style autocomplete, or a Select2 dropdown populated from the remote API, and the chosen id + name (and, for the Select2 widget, the serialized response row) are saved on the entity. A companion formatter renders the stored name. The module ships no admin settings form and no config schema; all configuration lives in the field's own storage/instance settings. Requires the Select2 module and Drupal 11.
